decks.notes: This deck focuses on using Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create powerful combos and overwhelm the opponent. It includes cards like Grisly Salvage, Thoughtseize, and Vessel of Nascency to search for key pieces, along with Liliana of the Veil for disruption. Traverse the Ulvenwald helps find important cards quickly, while Skysovereign, Consul Flagship and Esika's Chariot provide additional threats. Witherbloom Command and Can't Stay Away offer flexibility and utility. The deck aims to control the game and assemble its combo pieces for a decisive victory.

The deck focuses on aggressive plays with a mix of creatures and spells to quickly overwhelm opponents. It utilizes efficient creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Reckless Stormseeker to apply pressure early on, while also having removal and utility spells like Obliterating Bolt and The Akroan War to control the board. The inclusion of Jegantha as a companion adds an extra layer of consistency to the deck. Overall, the strategy revolves around deploying threats quickly and efficiently to take down the opponent before they can stabilize.

The deck focuses on utilizing the combo potential of Neoform to quickly bring out powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Tasigur, the Golden Fang. With a mix of control elements like Stubborn Denial and removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while assembling its combo pieces. Founding the Third Path and Strategic Planning help to dig for key cards, while Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana resources. The mana base is carefully constructed to ensure consistency in casting spells and activating abilities, with a mix of lands that provide colored mana and utility.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of low-cost, aggressive white creatures. By utilizing cards like Thalia's Lieutenant to boost the power of your creatures and recruiting more small creatures with cards like Recruitment Officer, you can quickly establish a strong board presence. Protecting your key creatures with cards like Dauntless Bodyguard and using Ossification to buff them even further can help you maintain control of the battlefield and pressure your opponent into submission.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with aggressive plays that involve sacrificing creatures for value. By utilizing cards like Witch's Oven and Mayhem Devil, the deck can generate incremental advantage by sacrificing creatures and dealing damage to the opponent. Additionally, utilizing Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push to control the board, while also utilizing the combo of Cauldron Familiar and Witch's Oven for consistent damage. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility to the deck's strategy.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on maintaining pressure on the opponent through a combination of efficient removal spells and powerful creature threats. Thoughtseize and Fatal Push help disrupt the opponent's game plan, while Bonecrusher Giant and Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger provide aggressive threats. The deck also utilizes graveyard synergies with cards like Graveyard Trespasser and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse to gain advantage over the opponent. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to apply constant pressure and disrupt the opponent's strategy while maintaining a strong board presence.

The main focus of this Dimir Control deck is to outvalue and outcontrol the opponent through a variety of counterspells, removal spells, and card advantage tools. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption and counterspells while utilizing card draw and graveyard recursion to maintain resources. Additionally, the inclusion of powerful finishers like Torrential Gearhulk and Kalitas, Traitor of Ghet allows the deck to close out the game once the opponent's resources have been depleted. The mana base is designed to support the deck's color requirements and provide utility with land destruction effects.

This aggressive Rakdos Sacrifice deck focuses on utilizing sacrifice synergies to control the board and trigger abilities from cards like Mayhem Devil and Cauldron Familiar. It also incorporates cards like Claim the Firstborn and Fatal Push for removal and disruption. The deck is designed to be fast-paced and relentless, using cards like Witch's Oven and Fabled of the Mirror-Breaker to generate value and maintain pressure on the opponent. Additionally, the inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion adds an extra element of versatility to the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard by casting cheap spells and triggering its ability. Using card draw spells like Opt and Pieces of the Puzzle to find the key pieces of the deck, combined with instants like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to trigger the Phoenix's ability. The deck also utilizes extra turn spells like Temporal Trespass to gain additional advantage. By being proactive and aggressive, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to establish their game plan.

Utilize untap effects and land tutors to quickly enable the Lotus Field combo, generating large amounts of mana and casting powerful spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum. The deck aims to create an explosive and unstoppable board state that overwhelms the opponent with a combination of ramp, control, and combo elements. By efficiently chaining together spells and utilizing powerful lands, the deck can quickly establish dominance and win the game in a single, decisive turn.

The deck focuses on using counterspells, board wipes, and creature removal to control the game while generating card advantage through effects like Dig Through Time and Narset, Parter of Veils. It also utilizes Shark Typhoon as a win condition and Hall of Storm Giants to close out games. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan, control the board, and outvalue the opponent in order to secure victory in a long game.

The deck focuses on utilizing Omnath, Locus of Creation to ramp up mana quickly and control the game through a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and card draw. The deck also includes Bring to Light to tutor for specific cards when needed, while Leyline Binding helps to lock down opponent's cards. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional value and flexibility. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue opponents by ramping up quickly and controlling the board to secure a win.

The main concept of this Dimir Control deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan through counter spells, removal, and card advantage, while generating threats with Shark Typhoon. The deck focuses on controlling the board with cards like Fatal Push, Sinister Sabotage, and Extinction Event, while maintaining card advantage with Dig Through Time and Memory Deluge. Narset, Parter of Veils helps shut down opponent's card draw, while Castle Vantress provides additional card selection. The deck also includes win conditions like The Meathook Massacre and Hall of Storm Giants to close out the game.

This deck focuses on quickly playing creatures to overpower the opponent, utilizing cards that provide strong board presence and synergy. It aims to control the battlefield with efficient creatures like Righteous Valkyrie and Skyclave Apparition, while also gaining life through Bishop of Wings and Resplendent Angel. The ramp provided by Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic allows for explosive plays with Emeria's Call and Collected Company. The land base is optimized for consistent mana production to support the aggressive playstyle of the deck.

Utilize the synergy between Lotus Field and various cards like Sylvan Scrying, Thespian's Stage, and Hidden Strings to ramp up mana quickly and set up powerful combos. Use cards like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum to overwhelm opponents with massive spells and abilities. Utilize bounce effects from Vizier of Tumbling Sands and Hope Tender to untap Lotus Field and generate even more mana. Use cards like Dark Petition and Mastermind's Acquisition to search for key combo pieces. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble powerful combinations to overwhelm opponents and achieve victory.

This deck focuses on utilizing creatures like Cauldron Familiar and Mayhem Devil to create a sacrifice engine, dealing damage to the opponent and controlling the board. With cards like Claim the Firstborn, Fatal Push, and Thoughtseize, it aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gaining incremental advantage through sacrificing creatures. The deck also includes ways to generate additional value through cards like Witch's Oven and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker. The mana base is designed to ensure consistency and access to the necessary colors for the deck's strategy.
